name: Arcee AI Trinity Large 400B
summary: Arcee's flagship blends several efficiency tricks into a DeepSeek-like coarse MoE design; the AA score shown here refers to the Trinity Large Thinking checkpoint.

attention: GQA with gated attention and 3:1 sliding-window/global attention

name: Antares 1B
summary: Cisco Foundation AI's compact terminal agent uses a dense Granite 4.0 backbone and is post-trained with SFT and GRPO for vulnerability localization.

name: BTL-3 27B
summary: Agent-oriented Qwen3.6-27B derivative that adds a rank-32 LoRA adapter for coding, structured tool use, and long multi-turn execution.

name: DeepSeek R1
summary: Reasoning-tuned DeepSeek model built on the V3 architecture rather than a new base design.
highlight: Architecture matches DeepSeek V3, including the MTP-1 path; the main change is the reasoning-oriented training recipe.

name: DeepSeek V3
summary: DeepSeek's flagship template kicked off the recent wave of large open MoE models.
highlight: Uses a dense prefix, shared expert, and MTP-1 objective to keep a very large model practical.

name: DeepSeek V3.2
summary: DeepSeek's successor keeps the V3 template but adds sparse attention to cut long-context costs.
highlight: Adds sparse attention while retaining the DeepSeek V3-style MTP path.

name: DeepSeek V4-Pro
summary: DeepSeek's flagship V4 preview scales to 1.6T parameters and introduces compressed sparse attention plus manifold-constrained hyper-connections for million-token contexts.
highlight: Uses 384 experts, 6 routed plus 1 shared expert per token, hash-based routing, compressed attention caches, and the V4 MTP path.

name: DeepSeek V4-Flash
summary: DeepSeek's efficient V4 preview keeps the million-token architecture while reducing the MoE scale to 284B parameters and 13B active parameters.
highlight: Uses 256 experts, 6 routed plus 1 shared expert per token, hash-based routing, compressed attention, and the V4 MTP path.

name: DeepSeek V4.1-Flash
summary: Causal encoder-decoder MoE with CSA2 cache sharing, Engram memory, and a million-token context. The figure shows the text backbone.
highlight: Decoder global KV comes from final encoder states. Single-Pass mHC mixes four residual streams around each attention and MoE sublayer.
scale: 552B backbone + 196B Engram; 8B active prefill, 16B active decode (2.9% of backbone)
attention: MLA-style CSA2 + SWA with cross-layer KV and sparse-index reuse

name: Dory1.0 4B
summary: NVIDIA's dense looped transformer applies a shared 20-block core twice between 8-block input and output stacks, using normalized GPT (nGPT) residual updates.
highlight: Reinjects the input-stack output before each recurrent pass. The 36 distinct blocks give 56 block applications by default, with L2-normalized residual updates and a 1,024-token attention window.

name: ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base
summary: Text-only base model with 37 heavily compressed attention layers and 6 MLA/DSA layers. Pretrained with up to 128K tokens of context; fine-tuning and inference support 1M tokens.
highlight: Four-stream mHC surrounds attention and latent MoE. Two sigmoid routers select 10 of 512 routed experts, alongside one always-active shared expert. ECHO reuses the final backbone layer for multi-token prediction.
licenseName: ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base Model License Agreement v1.0
attention: Gated HCA and MLA with DeepSeek Sparse Attention, VHA, and QK-Norm
layerMix: 37 HCA + 6 MLA/DSA; 1 dense FFN + 42 latent MoE

name: Ember-1
summary: Fireworks' Kimi K3 derivative, post-trained for shorter reasoning traces. Architecture details follow the published Kimi K3 base model; the diagram focuses on its text backbone.

attention: 3:1 Kimi Delta Attention and Gated MLA with NoPE

name: GLM-4.5 355B
summary: Agent-oriented instruction/reasoning hybrid that borrows DeepSeek's dense-prefix MoE layout.

name: GLM-4.5-Air
summary: Compact GLM-4.5 companion that keeps the same agent-oriented sparse MoE recipe at a smaller serving footprint.

name: GLM-4.7 355B
summary: Immediate GLM predecessor that stays closer to the older GLM-4.5 style before the MLA shift.

name: GLM-5 744B
summary: Huge GLM refresh that adopts both MLA and DeepSeek Sparse Attention for flagship-scale inference.

name: GLM-5.1
summary: Post-trained GLM refresh that keeps the GLM-5 backbone intact but targets stronger long-horizon agentic coding.
highlight: Architecture stays aligned with GLM-5, including its MTP-capable backbone; the main shift is post-training.

name: GLM-5.2
summary: Long-context GLM refresh that keeps the 744B sparse MoE backbone and adds IndexShare for 1M-token DSA inference.

name: GLM-5.3-Flash

attention: 3:1 Kimi Delta Attention and MLA with DeepSeek Sparse Attention

name: GLM-5.4
summary: Z.ai flagship Loop Transformer built on the 78-layer GLM-5 Sparse MoE backbone: loops 28 middle layers twice (26 opening + 28×2 looped + 24 closing = 106 effective layers) with β_k gated progressive updates and cross-loop hybrid KV/index sharing.
highlight: Achieves 106-layer 2T-3T class reasoning depth inside a ~750B 78-layer weight footprint via independent per-token iteration gates (β_k), shared Pass-1 sparse DSA indices, and a local 1024-token sliding-window KV cache on Loop Pass 2.
attention: MLA + DeepSeek Sparse Attention with Cross-Loop IndexShare & SWA(1024) Pass-2 KV

name: GPT-2 XL 1.5B

attention: GQA with QK-Norm and 5:1 sliding-window/global attention

name: Gemma 4 E2B
summary: Smallest Gemma 4 edge model keeps the family's hybrid attention stack and adds native audio on a phone-scale multimodal footprint. Uses per-layer embeddings, which add small layer-specific token vectors without scaling the full compute path, so its compute footprint is closer to 2.3B than a full 5.1B dense model.

highlight: Compact Qwen3 dense stack with QK-Norm and a 151k vocabulary.

name: Qwen3 8B
summary: Dense Qwen3 baseline used here to show how little OLMo 3 changed the overall decoder recipe.
highlight: Reference Qwen3 dense stack with QK-Norm and 8 KV heads.

name: Qwen3 Next 80B-A3B
summary: Efficiency-focused Qwen refresh that swaps standard attention for a DeltaNet-attention hybrid.
highlight: Adds many more experts, a shared expert, native 262k context, and MTP for speculative decoding.

name: Qwen3 Coder Flash 30B-A3B
summary: Coding-tuned Qwen model that keeps a straightforward grouped-query MoE stack instead of the newer hybrid-attention variants.
highlight: Uses 128 experts with 8 active per token and a native 256k context window for coding workloads.

name: Qwen3.5 397B
summary: Mainline Qwen refresh that brings the Next-style hybrid attention into the flagship series.
highlight: Turns the former Qwen3-Next side branch into the new core design with 512 experts and 17B active parameters.

name: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B
summary: Compact Qwen3.6 open-weight MoE that keeps the Qwen3.5 hybrid Gated DeltaNet/Gated Attention recipe while activating only about 3B parameters.
highlight: Uses 256 experts with 8 routed plus 1 shared expert active inside a 40-layer hybrid stack.

name: Qwen3.6 27B
summary: Dense Qwen3.6 model that keeps the Qwen3.5-style Gated DeltaNet/Gated Attention hybrid stack while replacing MoE blocks with dense FFNs.
highlight: Uses a 64-layer dense hybrid layout with 48 DeltaNet layers and 16 full-attention layers.

name: Qwen3.8 27B
summary: Dense 27B native vision-language model with a 64-layer Gated DeltaNet and Gated Attention language backbone; the figure omits the vision encoder and MTP head.
highlight: Uses a 64-layer 3:1 Gated DeltaNet/Gated Attention decoder with partial RoPE and one MTP layer.

name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B-A6B
summary: Experimental vision-language MoE whose text backbone combines Gated DeltaNet, micro-block QSA, four-branch gated residuals, and n-gram embeddings; the figure omits the vision encoder and MTP head.
highlight: Replaces full attention with micro-block QSA while using four gated residual branches and a 20M-entry n-gram embedding at layer 2.
scale: 125B core, 6B active (4.8% active); plus 51B n-gram embeddings and 4B MTP
attention: 3:1 Gated DeltaNet and Qwen Sparse Attention (QSA)

name: Reflection Beam 501B
summary: Text-only MoE decoder with three dense FFN layers followed by 49 expert layers. Each MoE layer activates 8 of 256 experts without a shared expert.
highlight: Combines 512-token local RoPE attention with global NoPE and query scaling. Uses sandwich RMSNorm, depth-scaled residuals, and a final logit softcap of 30.
attention: Gated GQA with QK-Norm and sliding-window/global attention

name: Recursive Flint 40B-A2.5B
summary: Recursive's coding model uses two dense FFN layers followed by 47 MoE layers. The active-parameter count includes the output head.
highlight: Uses top-6 routing over 256 experts plus one shared expert, with RoPE in local layers, NoPE in global layers, and a local window covering the current token and 512 preceding tokens.
attention: GQA with QK-Norm, learned attention sinks, and sliding-window/global attention

name: Sarvam 105B
summary: Larger Sarvam variant keeps the sparse MoE layout but switches from GQA to MLA.
highlight: Large vocabulary and strong Indic language support carried into the larger MLA-based sparse MoE variant.
attention: MLA with KV LayerNorm and NoPE + RoPE

name: Sarvam 30B
summary: Reasoning-oriented Indian-language sparse MoE that keeps GQA at the smaller size.
highlight: Large vocabulary and strong Indic language support paired with a reasoning-focused sparse MoE design.

name: SmolLM3 3B
summary: Compact dense model that experiments with leaving out positional encodings in selected layers.
highlight: Every fourth layer omits RoPE to test a NoPE-style cadence.

name: Solar Open 2
summary: Upstage's sparse hybrid alternates one gated GQA layer with three Kimi Delta Attention layers and reaches a 1M-token context without positional embeddings.
highlight: Uses a repeating gated-GQA/KDA hybrid stack, kernel-4 ShortConv in KDA, and top-8 routing over 320 experts plus one shared expert.
attention: 3:1 Kimi Delta Attention and gated GQA with NoPE

name: Soofi S 30B-A3B
summary: German-English base model that retrains the Nemotron 3 Nano architecture on 26.68T tokens with a fully documented data mixture.
highlight: Reuses the Nemotron 3 Nano architecture without modification, isolating the effect of a German-English data and training recipe.
attention: Mostly Mamba-2 with 6 GQA layers and no positional embeddings (NoPE)

name: Step 3.5 Flash 196B
summary: Throughput-oriented MoE model that stays competitive with much larger DeepSeek-style systems.
highlight: Uses MTP-3 during both training and inference for unusually high throughput.

name: Step-5 Preview 600B
summary: StepFun's 92-layer MoE pairs 512-token sliding-window attention with sparse GQA for a 1M-token context window; the figure shows the text decoder.
highlight: Uses top-512 sparse indexing with block size 8, 352 routed experts with 8 active plus one shared expert, and MTP-3. The first three and final backbone layers use dense FFNs with intermediate size 13,824.
attention: Gated GQA with QK-Norm and 3:1 sliding-window/sparse attention

name: Tiny Aya 3.35B
summary: Compact multilingual model from Cohere with a rare parallel transformer block.
highlight: Runs attention and the MLP in parallel while mixing RoPE with NoPE.

name: VibeThinker-3B
summary: Qwen2.5-Coder-based dense reasoner whose gains mainly come from verifier-driven post-training rather than a new block design.
highlight: Standard Qwen2.5-Coder-style dense stack strengthened by curriculum SFT, MGPO RL, Long2Short RL, offline self-distillation, and Instruct RL.

name: Xiaomi MiMo-V2-Flash 309B
summary: Large MoE model that pushes sliding-window attention harder than most contemporaries.
highlight: Uses an unusually small 128-token local window plus multi-token prediction.

name: Xiaomi MiMo-V2.5 310B
summary: Omnimodal sparse MoE model that extends the MiMo-V2-Flash backbone with vision and audio encoders.
highlight: Adds native image, video, and audio encoders to the MiMo-V2-Flash-style sparse MoE backbone with MTP support.

name: Xiaomi MiMo-V2.5-Pro 1.02T
summary: Trillion-parameter sparse MoE model for long-horizon agentic and software-engineering tasks.
highlight: Scales the MiMo-V2.5 Pro stack to 70 layers, 384 routed experts, top-8 routing, and a 1M-token context window.

name: Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL 309B
summary: Omnimodal sparse MoE model with the MiMo-V2.5 text backbone, mixed-domain reinforcement learning, and a five-layer DFlash speculative decoder.
highlight: Uses 256 routed experts with top-8 routing, one dense prefix layer, no shared experts, and a 128-token sliding window.

name: Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL 1.02T
summary: Omnimodal sparse MoE model with the MiMo-V2.5-Pro text backbone, mixed-domain reinforcement learning, and a five-layer DFlash speculative decoder.
highlight: Uses 384 routed experts with top-8 routing, one dense prefix layer, no shared experts, and a 128-token sliding window.

name: ZAYA1-8B
summary: Zyphra's compact reasoning MoE pairs CCA/GQA attention updates with top-1 routed expert FFN updates to keep fewer than 1B parameters active per token.
highlight: Key detail is CCA/GQA attention, which performs attention in a compressed latent space while keeping a 4:1 GQA layout. Sidenote: the config lists 80 alternating layer entries, equivalent to 40 CCA/GQA attention updates paired with 40 top-1 MoE FFN updates.
attention: CCA with 4:1 GQA, RoPE, and Q/K L2 norm
layerMix: 40 CCA/GQA attention + 40 top-1 MoE FFN entries

name: North Mini Code 30B-A3B
summary: Cohere's compact agentic coding MoE adapts the parallel Cohere2-MoE block to a 30B total, 3B active model.
highlight: Runs attention and MoE in parallel, with RoPE in sliding-window layers, NoPE in global layers, and top-8 routing over 128 experts.

name: Command A+ 218B-A25B
summary: Cohere's open sparse MoE model scales the Command A parallel transformer block to 218B total parameters while keeping 25B active per token.
highlight: Runs attention and MoE in parallel, which Cohere reports gives similar quality to a sequential block with better throughput.

name: xLSTM 7B
summary: Recurrent 7B language model that replaces self-attention with xLSTM blocks built around matrix memory.
highlight: Stateful recurrent architecture aimed at fast long-context inference without an explicit context window.
attention: No self-attention; mLSTM recurrent layers with matrix memory

name: Inkling
summary: Thinking Machines Lab's native multimodal model combines a 66-layer sparse MoE decoder with a 5:1 mix of local and global GQA.
highlight: Uses learned relative-position bias instead of RoPE and adds four short convolutions to each decoder layer.
attention: GQA with QK-Norm and learned relative-position bias in a 5:1 sliding-window/global pattern
